guarantees.claim: d[1] is assigned g[0] and d[0] is assigned g[1]; the function returns d.

uncertain_points.claim: Function named aes_square_gf2p2 performs bit-swap (d[1]=g[0], d[0]=g[1]), but name suggests squaring in GF(2^2). Correctness depends on basis representation; verify against AES S-box composite-field arithmetic spec.
uncertain_points.risk: If the bit-swap is not the squaring operation for the chosen basis, the S-box would be wrong, breaking AES encryption/decryption.
